surface: Web API GET https://slack.com/api/users.list (deleted flag marks deactivated members)
auth_scope: users:read + users:read.email (bot token; profile.email is only returned with users:read.email)

pagination.exhaustion_method: follow response_metadata.next_cursor until it is empty; limit=200

rate_limits: Web API rate-limit Tier 2 (~20 requests/minute) for users.list; honor Retry-After on HTTP 429
history_caveats: STATE only: the deleted flag shows current deactivation state, not when deactivation happened - timing evidence needs the Audit Logs API (Enterprise Grid only)
